_note: S2 core lexicon v2 (plan §8.3). Built by scripts/build_ai_lexicon_v2.py; matcher in subliminal_learning.gkd.ai_screen. 'ai' = instant terms (any hit flags); 'ai_core' = v1 ai_core (positive-control selection); 'two_stage' = [entity, negative] pairs that flag on co-occurrence. v1 (data/ai_discourse_lexicon.json) is unchanged.
matcher: nfkc+lower; boundary=(?<![a-z])...(?![a-z]); word join=[\s\-_]+; dotted acronym for single-word [a-z]{2,4}; two_stage=co-occurrence anywhere

table11.citation: Tice et al., arXiv 2601.10160v2, App. H.3, Table 11, p. 44

harvest.rule: word_filter == True rows; keyword normalized (NFKC, lower, single spaces); case variants summed; documents >= 100
